svg.title: Ongoing / Proposal: Ongoing as a software inventory
svg.desc: Phase 1 has landed: entries, the field registry, the entries API, and the CLI verbs over them are current inside this subsystem. What is still drawn as proposed is the rest of the settled design — one query grammar for every surface, collectors declared as providers behind a host adapter, and a keyboard-first shell over all of it.. Architecture structure.
